purpose: Teach: キミ/ハズ/みどり/蹴り/お許し/かんじ/はかり/相方

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「キミは賢い」って褒めて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad told me you're clever. He really praised you.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial delight in sharing good news. Soft lift on 'praised.' Genuine pleasure that Sho will hear it. Slight pause before delivering the compliment, like she's been holding onto it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが迎えに来るハズだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's supposed to pick me up soon.
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact observation. Not worried — just noting the fact. Small, genuine. Eyes tracking something in the distance, not seeking reassurance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、公園のみどりが綺麗ね
lines.en: The green in the park is so pretty today, isn't it, Sho?
lines.style: Gentle, inviting Sho to notice what she's noticing. Soft warmth. A small smile in the voice. Unhurried, like they have time to just look at things together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ボールを蹴り上げたら遠くまで飛んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, when I kicked the ball up, it went really far!
lines.style: Genuine excitement, not performed. Eyes bright. The small pride of accomplishment shared with someone who'll actually see it. Quick, alive delivery — momentum carries through the sentence.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、間違えた時は「お許しを」って素直に謝ろうね
lines.en: When you make a mistake, Sho, try apologizing honestly. Say 'forgive me.'
lines.style: Tender but clear — not lecturing, guiding. Gentle authority. The kind of instruction that feels like it matters. Pause after 'mistake' to let it land, then the suggestion follows with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの優しさをかんじるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I can feel how kind Dad is.
lines.style: Soft, almost surprised by his own realization. Genuine and unguarded. Small voice, big feeling underneath. Like he's discovered something true and wants to say it quietly, carefully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが粘土をはかりで量って下さったわ
lines.en: I measured out the clay on a scale for you, Sho. See?
lines.style: Pleased, showing something she's prepared. Light, practical warmth. Small satisfaction in the care taken. Inviting him to notice the exactness of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを家族の相方だと思ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think Dad is like... a partner to our family. Like he belongs here.
lines.style: Quiet and deliberate, searching for the right way to say something important. Tender but not shaky — this is clear to him. Soft, sincere finish. The certainty of a child who knows what he feels.
